subject: Pilot finale stipend for Novaflow - approval to offer
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: one-off pilot stipend for Novaflow conversion (summary attached)

Hi team,

Quick ask — Novaflow (contact: Jordan Miller) is at the finish line of a four-week pilot. Usage has been healthy (approx 120k tokens/day last 3 days) but they need a small economics nudge to sign an annual commitment by EoQ. Sales view: high intent, legal/compliance OK, procurement ready, blocked only by a last-minute cost conversation with Ops/finance.

Ask: approve a one-time pilot stipend: 30k token credit + a 4-week trial extension (no additional seat/license) as a conversion incentive. I’ve attached a short pilot summary and the proposed offer doc. If we approve, I’ll send the formal offer to Jordan & cc Samir.

Why this is reasonable:
- Renewal intent: they committed to >6M tokens/year on a 12-month plan if the pilot performance holds
- LTV signal: product-led expansion expected from two distinct business units
- Time: procurement prefers vendor lock before next billing cycle (EoQ push)

Risks/controls I propose:
- Token credit must be 1x one-time and expire 30 days after issuance
- Limit total billable tokens on hosted plan to a pre-approved cap; we can enforce model fallbacks if they exceed thresholds
- Offer only applies to the production contract signed within 30 days of offer acceptance

Attachments: novaflow-pilot-summary.xlsx (pilot metrics + screenshots)

Can I get approval to proceed to customer?

Thanks,
Irene
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off pilot stipend for Novaflow conversion (summary attached)

Irene — thanks for the concise ask and the data. I’m fine approving a one-off stipend here given the renewal signal, but please reduce the credit to 25k tokens instead of 30k to keep precedent conservative.

Conditions:
- Stipend expires 30 days after issuance
- Offer must be tied to the initial production SKU and not combinable with any other commercial concessions
- Document the approval in the deal notes (HubSpot) and attach the signed acceptance before we honor the credit

If Lauren or Finance pushes back we can revisit, but provisional thumbs up from me.

-Markus
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off pilot stipend for Novaflow conversion (summary attached)

Irene — quick follow: please add the HubSpot deal link (deal id NOVA-56789) and a one-paragraph ROI justification (how credit increases probability of close and expected ARR). I want the approval language to include the exact cap and the SLA that kicks in post-conversion. Also confirm we won’t be extending any metric-based credits beyond this one-off.

Once that’s added I’ll sign off. I don’t need Finance looped in now but keep them in the loop per the deal notes.

-Lauren
Senior Director, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference

---

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Oct 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: one-off pilot stipend for Novaflow conversion (summary attached)

Quick SE note: if we send the stipend, we should implement a usage cap and a model fallback rule in the customer’s routing policy so they can’t burn the credit on a non-goal-aligned workload. I can add the routing and batching guardrails — will need a short config change on Dedicated routing (or policy if they stay on hosted).

Also recommend adding a token-metered tracking dashboard to the offer so both sides see consumption against the stipend in real time. Happy to draft the implementation steps.

-Ben
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Miller <jm@novaflow.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.p@novaflow.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 2 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: Pilot stipend + extension — Novaflow pilot finale

Jordan / Samir — thanks again for the partnership this month. We’re excited by the results and would like to help you cross the last mile.

Offer (one-time, limited):
- 25,000 token credit applied to your Redwood account (to be consumed within 30 days of issuance)
- 4-week free extension of the trial environment (same configuration)
- Implementation note: we will apply a usage cap and enable a fallback model to control burn. Ben will reach out to align on the routing policy.

Conditions:
- Offer valid if Novaflow signs the annual production contract (NOVA-56789) within 30 days of acceptance
- Credit is non-transferable and cannot be combined with other promotional discounts
- We will issue the credit after we receive the signed acceptance (DocuSign link to follow)

I’ve attached the formal offer PDF for signature (pilot-stipend-offer-20271002.pdf) and added the deal notes in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/56789

Next step: If this aligns, accept the attached offer and we’ll schedule a 20-minute handoff to finalize billing and routing.

Warmly,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142

Attachments referenced: pilot-stipend-offer-20271002.pdf
